method: Actual native application handlers, live shared records read via GET, private exact-source candidate. Editable draft test overrides capability only within one synchronous browser call and traps SDK writes; it does not dispatch native Save. Large-pane disposal uses a clearly labelled DOM-only threshold fixture. Financial amounts and native records are not edited.
privacy: Raw records and screenshots retained only in private workspace evidence.
